kjv: [there are] no bands in their death: but their strength [is] firm
mine: they have no pangs until death; their bodies are fat and sleek
note: hartsubbot are "bonds, pangs", and lemotam "to their death" is often redivided lamo tam "for them; sound (is their body)"; either way the point is that the wicked suffer no pains, not that their death is free of bonds.

kjv: and waters of a full [cup] are wrung out to them
mine: and find no fault in them
note: umey male' yimmatsu lamo "and waters of fullness are drained by them" is obscure; I take it as the people eagerly drinking in the wicked's words, while the KJV renders it literally with an italic "cup".
